export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec108/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json,hashlib,pathlib
R="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec108/fx"
S=R+"/plugins/system-spec-harness"
cmds={
'aggregate':['python3','-B',S+'/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/aggregate-completeness.py','--report',R+'/eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json','--spec-dir',R+'/system-spec','--session','291b5927-942a-47da-9f26-036b5595e31b'],
'coverage':['python3','-B',S+'/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py','--matrix',R+'/system-spec/spec-state.json','--require-complete','--require-basis','--require-foundation'],
'citation':['python3','-B',S+'/scripts/validate-source-citation.py','--targets',R+'/system-spec/spec-state.json','--references',R+'/system-spec/fetched-references.json','--state',R+'/system-spec/spec-state.json','--repo-root',R],
'schema':['python3','-B',R+'/plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py','--graph',R+'/.dev-graph/state/graph.json','--repo-root',R,'--strict-artifact-readiness'],
'helper':['python3','-B',R+'/plugins/dev-graph/skills/run-dev-graph-system-spec/scripts/build-evaluation-context.py','--context-receipt',R+'/eval-log/c24-receipt.json','--output','eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json'],
}
for k,c in cmds.items():
    p=subprocess.run(c,capture_output=True,text=True)
    print('==',k,p.returncode); print(p.stdout[-1500:]); print(p.stderr[-800:])
r=json.load(open('eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json'))
mm=[]
for k,v in r['artifact_snapshot']['artifacts'].items():
    h=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(k).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if h!=v: mm.append(k)
print('snapshot mismatches',mm,len(r['artifact_snapshot']['artifacts']))
print('system-spec files',sorted(str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('system-spec').rglob('*') if p.is_file()))
print('spec_dir eq', r['spec_dir']==R+'/system-spec', 'verdict', r['verdict'], {k:v['verdict'] for k,v in r['aspects'].items()})
print([k for k in r.keys()])
PY
